text.body: ॥ mārkaṇḍeyaśivāṣṭakam ॥ sadā godāvaryāstaṭanikaṭavāsaṃ paśupatiṃ vadānyaṃ sarveśaṃ varadamakhalārthaikaghaṭanam । śivaṃ gaurīnāthaṃ śaśidharamanantārcitapadaṃ bhaje mārkaṇḍeya bhasitaniṭalaṃ bhavyanaṭanam ॥ 1 sadā kailāsādrisvapadamanaghaṃ sarvajagatāṃ prabhu śrīviśveśaṃ prakaṭitaparaṃdhāma saratham । naṭeśaṃ gaurīśaṃ lalitaravicandrānaladṛśaṃ bhaje ...॥ 2 mahādevaṃ sarvaṃ madhuripusakhaṃ maṅgalakaraṃ paraṃśambhuṃ sāmbaṃ puramathanamīśaṃ bhavaharam । smarāriṃ sarvajñaṃ smaraharamanādiṃ mṛgadharaṃ bhaje ... ॥ 3 pradoṣeṣu svāntaṃ prabalataratauryatrikakṛtaṃ trayatriṃśatkoṭitriśadapravaraiḥ saṃparivṛtam। ramāvāṇīndra śrīpati vidhikṛtollāsyakaraṇaṃ bhaje ...॥ 4 bhavānīhṛtpadmāruṇamahini nīlotpalagalaṃ sahasrāre padmāniśamavivasantaṃ suragurum । stutibhyo bhaktānāṃ nikhila sukhadaṃ susthirapadaṃ bhaje ... ॥ 5 śivastvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ sakalabhuvanastvaṃ raviśaśī nabhastvaṃ kāyastvaṃ sakalajagadātmā tvamasi bho । yatirdeyaṃ sānte sukhatamakhilaṃ jaiminivaraiḥ bhaje ॥ 6 sadoccairāhvānaṃ haraharahareti pravacasā sadā bhaktyānando śivaśiva śiveti svamanasā । stutiṃ vāraṃ vāraṃ bhavabhavamabhaveti pratibhayā bhaje ... ॥ 7 yamāhūtaṃ bhītaṃ munivaranutaṃ pāśaniharti bhavantaṃ sadbhaktyā hṛdi śiśumavantaṃ karuṇayā। śaraṇyaṃ bhaktānāṃ paramagatimīśaṃ paraśivaṃ bhaje mārkaṇḍeyam ॥ 8 śrīkolācalasadvaṃśavāridhestu sudhākaraḥ । yajñeśo bhūsuraścakre mārkaṇḍeyaśivāṣṭakam ।। 9
